title: Grateful Dead Live at Wembley Empire Pool on 1972-04-08
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > M-Audio 2496 > Wavelab 5.0 (L3 multimaximizer, crossfades) > CD WAVE > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stunning Dark Star into Sugar Magnolia with high‑energy jams and superb performance.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the band’s chemistry shine, especially during the soaring Dark Star and its seamless transition into a fiery Sugar Magnolia. Reviewers rave about the jam‑heavy back half of the set, highlighting Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) and a potent One More Saturday Night encore, despite noting Bob's slightly limited vocal range.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (high energy, standout jams) and the soundboard recording quality; limited number of reviews reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical complaints; reviewers note clear mix with harp and keyboards well‑balanced, indicating a crisp, professional soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds from an expansive Dark Star into a groovy Sugar Magnolia, then maintains momentum with focused jams and a strong encore, demanding attentive listening.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's vocal range is described as a little narrow in this performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work is audible and adds depth to the jam sections.
